recent.text: Johnson banks in a 3-pointer from the top of the key to give the Mavs an 80-70 lead with 2:41 left. This is his third straight game with a 3. That was also Flagg's 11th assist of the night. He has a double-double with 14 points to go along with 5 rebounds.
